mistake.headline:
Hands up.
Elbows down.
mistake.body: The weights are in the right spot, but your elbows aren't. If your elbow isn't high, your delt isn't really being worked.

fix.headline:
Lead with
your elbows.
fix.body: Raise them to shoulder height with your elbows high. Tilt the dumbbells like you're [em]dumping out two jugs of water.[/em] Then lower slow.

cues.title: 3 cues
cues.subtitle: for side laterals
items: Lead with your elbows, not your hands.
Go light: 5 or 10 pounds. No rocking.

blocks.title: Send it
blocks.text: to the guy whose side laterals look like a chicken dance.
